text:
incident-bot: 🚨 SEV-2 — Observed sustained KV cache growth (+X pages/min) and downstream continuous-batching latency surge in us-west-2. Trigger: paging > 95% for cache-shard-7, avg token latency 3x SLO. Auto-escalation to oncall-alex.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. slicing into svc=runtime and infra=kv. starting timeline and impact assessment.

sam-ryan: seeing same in metrics — a ramp at 17:34 UTC, correlates with a deploy from yesterday (commit: a1b2c3f). KV resident set doubled.

maria-ml: streaming cadence graphs show partial flushes piling up; streaming worker queues spike then stall. Could be continuous-batching interaction with eviction.

ops-liz: @oncall-alex any customer-facing errors? I see increased 504s in a subset of routes.

oncall-alex: yes, a few customer 5xx/timeout tickets opened. product-chris flagged two enterprise customers experiencing slow responses for chat streaming. marking P1 for customer impact.

sam-ryan: logs from cache-shard-7: `evict_loop: scanned pages=12000, free_pages=2, backpressure=1`. Also repeated `kv_page_pin failure` traces around the same time.

maria-ml: prioritized check: are batching thresholds (max_batch_tokens) changed? I don't see config changes in the last 48h besides the canary tweak we rolled yesterday.

ops-liz: quick mitigation idea: throttle continuous-batching on affected hosts to reduce in-flight KV pins, and increase eviction headroom. We can push a hotfix config to reduce `continuous_batch_window_ms` from 30ms -> 10ms for canary group.

oncall-alex: good. execute steps and coordinate canary. I'll request a limited rollout to shard group A (hosts 7-10).

incident-bot: @oncall-alex requested config hotfix: `runtime.batch.continuous_window_ms=10` to canary group. Change ID: HOTFIX-2035-01. Applying to hosts: runtime-usw-7,8,9.

infra-bot: deploy started for HOTFIX-2035-01 on runtime-usw-7..9. CI checks passed.

sam-ryan: while we roll, I'm attaching a snippet of the offending stack traces to the thread: ```
[evict] pin_page failed id=0x7f3a2 file=kv_cache.cc:478
[batch] flush attempt=0 queued_tokens=2048
[stream] partial_flush timer expired but KV lock held
```

maria-ml: hypothesis: continuous-batcher holds KV pins longer when batches hit the prefetch path; combined with a regression in the eviction sampler, we can get catastrophic page pressure.

ops-liz: infra snapshot shows disk-backed paging increased by 8x on runtime-usw-7. Rebalance attempt queued but failing due to lock contention.

oncall-alex: after HOTFIX-2035-01 applied to 7/8, initial telemetry shows paging rate halved and token latency trending down. Leaving canary for 5m.

product-chris: customer update? we should send an interim message to impacted customers acknowledging we're mitigating and expect degraded streaming for ~30-60m.

oncall-alex: agreed. ops-liz can you draft a short note? keep it scoped.

ops-liz: draft: "We’re investigating elevated streaming latency in us-west-2 affecting some chat streaming sessions. We’ve deployed a targeted mitigation to reduce batch windowing on affected hosts; we expect improvements in the next 15–30 minutes. We’ll follow up with a root cause update." Approving? :thumbsup:

product-chris: :thumbsup: send.

ops-liz: sent to customers at 17:49 UTC.

sam-ryan: canary metrics at +7m: cache pages_alloc rate down 52%, evict_loop churn down 60%, streaming partial-flush errors reduced but not eliminated.

maria-ml: good sign. however we still see sporadic stalls correlated with specific model sizes (1.4B and 3B) — likely different KV access patterns.

oncall-alex: plan B ready: if second-tier hosts show persistent pressure, we'll apply a soft-eviction change to increase `kv.eviction_target_pct` by +8% to create headroom, and temporarily disable prefetch on those routes. Approval?

sam-ryan: approve from eng side. Preflight: ensure metrics alert thresholds adjusted so we don't cascade more alerts.

infra-bot: HOTFIX-2035-02 prepared (kv.eviction_target_pct +8). Awaiting manual trigger.

oncall-alex: triggering HOTFIX-2035-02 to runtime-usw-10..14 now.

infra-bot: HOTFIX-2035-02 applied. Verification in progress.

sam-ryan: verification: eviction headroom increased, paging stabilizing across the cluster. token latency back within 1.2x SLO for most routes. some legacy-streaming routes still ~1.5x.

maria-ml: follow-up trace shows a corner-case in partial flush logic: when KV pin fails inside `flush_pending()` we leave a `partial_flush_token` in queue without triggering immediate retry — causing cadence gaps. I'll open a PR with a simpler failure handling path.

oncall-alex: create the PR and link here. For now, keep hotfixes in place and schedule a rolling patch that includes the failure-handling fix in next deploy window.

maria-ml: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kv/merge_requests/412 — fixes `flush_pending()` to always schedule a retry on pin failure and adds metrics for `partial_flush_retries`.

product-chris: we should include the fix in the next canary and coordinate with QA on streaming regressions. Also standard post-mortem and customer RCA.

ops-liz: customer impact summary so far: 3 enterprise customers experienced degraded streaming (increased latency and occasional disconnects) for ~45 minutes. No data loss reported. Notifications sent.

oncall-alex: Incident status: mitigation successful, rolling hotfixes applied cluster-wide, monitoring for recurrence. Moving to MONITORING.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=MONITORING, severity=SEV-2 -> reduced. Next steps: postmortem owner assigned = sam-ryan, postmortem due in 72h, include timeline, config delta, and customer comms.

sam-ryan: I'll own the postmortem. initial items: correlate the deploy (a1b2c3f) with the eviction sampler change, add unit/integration tests for partial flush retry, and add QA canary scenarios for small-model streaming.

product-chris: ok. please include a public-friendly RCA draft for the customers and a changelog note.

ops-liz: logging action items: - add `partial_flush_retries` metric to dashboards - make `continuous_batch_window_ms` dynamic and auto-scale down under paging pressure - improve paging alert to include `kv_page_pin` error rate.

maria-ml: I'll send the PR for tests and the retry fix, target next deploy (48h).

oncall-alex: thanks team. closing incident thread in 1h if no regressions.

incident-bot: Closing note appended: incident closed to MONITORING at 18:18 UTC. Postmortem owner: sam-ryan.
